propositions: The rate-limit sweep's file list is hardcoded and scoped to four transport modules; renaming or moving a classified mutating method to an unswept sibling module escapes the sweep without triggering the completeness assertion.
An anti-drift guard must reject any classified mutating name appearing outside the four swept modules unless its body is a pure same-name self.transport delegation with arguments forwarded unchanged.

The existing facades backend.py::set_relationship and backend.py::add_comment are the only currently colliding definitions and must pass the guard; any new or moved unswept non-facade using a classified name must fail.

The sweep's file list should remain explicit and scoped to the transport layer rather than widening to a package-wide glob that would pull 90 unrelated members into mutating/non-mutating classification policy.

Acceptance criterion AC3 must be rewritten to reflect that the anti-drift guard detects drift over the declared transport surface rather than guaranteeing detection of new transport modules with new mutating names.
